_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for report figures that are NOT yet sourced from the database — hand-transcribed values and stopgaps pending a real extractor or data-entry wiring. Edit this file to update those numbers; changes apply on the next PDF/preview generation, no restart needed. Do NOT re-scatter these back into the page_*.py generators. Each top-level section names the page generator that consumes it. '_doc' keys (at any level) are ignored by the loader.

sail_mines._doc: page_sail_mines.py — 'SAIL Mines Production & Despatch Performance'. Charts are in million tonnes; the iron-ore group table is in '000 T. Stopgap per direct instruction 2026-08-27, a placeholder until real series / mine-level actuals exist. Chart colours stay in the page module (presentation, not data).

iron_ore_group_kt._doc: Sales of Iron Ore (Booked Qty / Despatch) only, delinked from the mine-level rollups per direct instruction 2026-08-27 (mine-level Booked Quantity actuals were never entered). iron_ore_prod/iron_ore_despatch were restored to the live mine-level rollup (db.get_iron_ore_group_rollup_monthly) on 2026-09-12, once real mine-level despatch actuals existed, so they no longer live here. Each item -> [APP, YTD Actual, YTD CPLY] in '000 T. The 'SAIL' rows stay derived (CGoM + OGoM + JGoM) and are NOT listed here.

special_steel_physical._doc: page_special_steel_physical.py — 'Special Steel Plants Physical Performance'. cur-FY YTD Actual overrides in Tonnes, plant -> series -> value; wins over the derived / production_table figure. Empty since 2026-08-28: SSP Carbon/Stainless YTD Actual now come from production_table (Carbon Steel Production actuals + Saleable-minus-Carbon), and SSP Carbon monthly ABP from production_plan_table. Add an entry back only for a series with no usable production_table source.

key_parameters._doc: page_key_parameters.py — 'Inter Plant Performance Comparison' page. Empty since 2026-09-06: the last remaining hand-transcribed figure, 'ss_in_finished' (Special Steel in Finished Steel %), is now live-computed as Special Finished Steel Despatch / Finished Steel Despatch (_ss_in_fs_pct) instead of transcribed from the comparative PDF. Cost of Production (HM/CS/SS and, since 2026-08-28, BF Coke + Sinter) comes from cost_trend_monthly (the DB); RLTIFR is techno_data 'General' unit (key 'rltifr'). Add an entry back only for a figure with no usable DB source.
